```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (23.0, 16.0, 26.0),       # diff pair gm/Id (weak/moderate inversion)
    "L1":    (0.4, 0.18, 1.0),         # diff pair L
    "gmidp": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),        # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.3, 1.5),          # PMOS mirror L
    "Itail": (90e-6, 60e-6, 98e-6),    # tail current
    "gmidt": (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),        # tail / reference mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),          # tail / reference L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It = p["Itail"]
    Ih = It / 2.0

    # PMOS mirror load
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=0.8)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=mp.vgs)
    vo = vdd - mp.vgs

    # Diff pair: iterate the common-source node (body effect included)
    vs = 0.2
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=max(vo - vs, 0.1), vsb=vs)
        vs = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.05)

    # Tail and reference diode share gm/Id and L
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], It, vds=vs)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mr.vgs)

    # Divider sets the reference-side gate to 0.75 V
    Rtot = 2.4e6
    Rbot = Rtot * vcm / vdd
    Rtop = Rtot - Rbot

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "tail", "vss", m1)     # signal side drives the output
    n.dev("M1B", "pd", "vref", "tail", "vss", m1)     # reference side
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pd", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M2B", "pd", "pd", "vdd", "vdd", mp)        # mirror diode
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MNR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.R("RT", "vdd", "vref", Rtop)
    n.R("RB", "vref", "vss", Rbot)

    # First-order predictions
    gds_t = m1.gds + mp.gds
    A = m1.gm / gds_t
    Ctot = cl + m1.cdd + m1.cgd + mp.cdd + mp.cgd
    f3db = gds_t / (2 * PI * Ctot)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Ctot)
    power = vdd * (It + iref + vdd / Rtot)
    swing = (vdd - mp.vdsat - 0.05) - (vs + m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3db, "gbw": gbw,
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vo, "swing": swing}
```
